scope: 38 standalone enum/member/attribute/type-alias annotations in 14 production modules; leading class/function docs not part of this batch. All project lib/server sources lack enabled use_attribute_docstrings, and affected modules have no __doc__/getdoc consumers. These expressions are explanatory source annotations, not assigned field metadata or tool definitions.

annotations.before: wire 层不兼容，换下一档还有机会。
annotations.after: Wire-layer incompatibility; the next tier may still work.

annotations.before: 模型输出反复不合规，换约束更弱的档只会更差。
annotations.after: Repeatedly invalid model output; weaker constraints would only worsen it.

annotations.before: 与结构化输出能力无关，交调用方判定。
annotations.after: Unrelated to structured-output capability; let the caller decide.

annotations.before: 本次实际请求的完整地址；预览与请求同一个字符串。
annotations.after: Complete URL actually requested this time; preview and request use the same string.

annotations.before: 成片的字幕方式：烧入字幕，或不烧入、得到干净的画面。
annotations.after: Final-cut subtitle mode: burn subtitles in, or omit them for clean footage.

annotations.before: 产物已在供应商侧生成、只是没取回来：接续原任务取件，不重新提交、不再计费。
annotations.after: The provider already generated the artifact but it was not retrieved: resume retrieval from the original task, without resubmission or another charge.

annotations.before: 剪映草稿的旁白版本：带旁白版本多一条旁白轨，只对 TTS 配音项目开放。
annotations.after: Jianying draft narration variant: the narrated variant adds a narration track and is available only for TTS-dubbed projects.

annotations.before: 请求时长基准本身就是档位成员，申请值与基准一致。
annotations.after: The requested-duration basis is itself a tier member; requested value equals the basis.

annotations.before: 向上取档：成片长于请求时长基准。
annotations.after: Round up to a tier: output is longer than the requested-duration basis.

annotations.before: 请求时长基准超过最大档位，按最大档位申请：成片短于请求基准。
annotations.after: The requested-duration basis exceeds the maximum tier; request the maximum, yielding output shorter than the basis.

annotations.before: 时长这一维不由 ArcReel 取档：申请值就是规划值，端点自己决定成片多长。
annotations.after: ArcReel does not select a duration tier: request the planned value; the endpoint determines output length.

annotations.before: 撤回排队消息的结果：``withdrawn`` 已撤回并移出排队，``accepted`` 已被 Agent 接收、照常进入对话。
annotations.after: Queued-message withdrawal result: ``withdrawn`` removed it from CLI and queue; ``accepted`` means the Agent received it and it enters conversation normally.

annotations.before: 立即发送的结果：``sent`` 已以 now 优先级重新送入，``accepted`` 已被 Agent 接收、不再重发。
annotations.after: Immediate-send result: ``sent`` resubmitted it with now priority; ``accepted`` means the Agent already received it and it is not resent.

annotations.before: CLI 报告时有立即发送的消息尚未被接纳：这次丢弃来自被它打断的那一轮。
annotations.after: At CLI report time, an immediately sent message remains unaccepted: this discard belongs to the turn it interrupted.

annotations.before: 生成类工具的成功值：远程即返的批次句柄，或 :func:`generation_result_outcome` 给出的终态结果。
annotations.after: Generation-tool success value: an immediately returned remote batch handle, or terminal result from :func:`generation_result_outcome`.

annotations.before: 剧本纯文件名；带路径分隔符或为空时请求校验失败。
annotations.after: Bare script filename; empty values or path separators fail request validation.

annotations.before: 显式点名的目标 ID；空数组无效——省略参数才表示只补缺失项。
annotations.after: Explicit target IDs; an empty array is invalid. Omit the argument to fill only missing items.

annotations.before: 预留给服务端原生视频 MLLM 审阅，恒为 None。
annotations.after: Reserved for server-native video MLLM review; always None.

annotations.before: 按首次引用顺序；变体族展开为 ``applies_to`` 声明的全部轴值。
annotations.after: First-reference order; variant families expand into every axis value declared by ``applies_to``.

annotations.before: 给定宫格 ID，返回队列里仍有活动任务（queued / running）的那些。
annotations.after: Given grid IDs, return those still owning active (queued / running) queue tasks.

annotations.before: 新建记录并入队。
annotations.after: Create a record and enqueue it.

annotations.before: 同一组分镜的宫格正在生成：沿用该记录，入队按资源去重落到在途任务上，不重复计费。
annotations.after: The same storyboard group already has a generating grid: reuse its record; resource deduplication joins the in-flight task without another charge.

annotations.before: 缺失即生成时，同一组分镜的联合图已就绪而未切分：等用户审阅后切分落格，不重生成。
annotations.after: In missing-only generation, the same group has a ready but unsplit combined grid image: await user review and split into storyboard slots without regenerating.

annotations.before: 本次无需生成：点名未覆盖这张宫格，或它的分镜图都还可用。
annotations.after: No generation needed: explicit targets exclude this grid, or all its storyboard images remain usable.

annotations.before: 这张宫格有自己的受阻分镜。
annotations.after: This grid has blocked storyboards of its own.

annotations.before: 同一组分镜的最新宫格记录；``IN_FLIGHT`` / ``UNSPLIT`` 时即被沿用或等待切分的那条。
annotations.after: The latest grid record for the same storyboard group; ``IN_FLIGHT`` / ``UNSPLIT`` means the record being reused or awaiting splitting.

annotations.before: 缺失即生成下，所在分组要重画、但自身分镜图仍可用而不在本次目标里的分镜。
annotations.after: In missing-only mode, storyboards with usable images that are not targets, although their group needs redrawing.

annotations.before: 带自身原因受阻的分镜；非空即整批不建任务。
annotations.after: Storyboards blocked for their own reasons; any entries prevent creating tasks for the whole batch.

annotations.before: 本身健康、因同批受阻而未创建任务的分镜。
annotations.after: Healthy storyboards for which no tasks were created because the same batch contains blockers.

annotations.before: 经过引用与提示词准入判定的全部分镜（待新生成的各张宫格覆盖的分镜）。
annotations.after: All storyboards assessed for reference and prompt admission (those covered by each grid to be newly generated).

annotations.before: 剧本里各分镜已登记的分镜图路径；报告失败时据此带上旧图。
annotations.after: Registered storyboard-image paths in the script; use them to retain old images when reporting failure.

annotations.before: 停在 pending / generating 却已没有活动任务的宫格记录；提交时按已结束的记录清理。
annotations.after: Grid records stuck in pending / generating without active tasks; clean them up as finished records at submission.

annotations.before: 规划所在的临界区；落地时它必须仍未结束，否则 ``abandoned_grid_ids`` 已不可信。
annotations.after: The critical section owning planning; it must still be active when applying the plan, or ``abandoned_grid_ids`` is no longer reliable.

annotations.before: 不保留版本历史。
annotations.after: Do not retain version history.

annotations.before: 每个资源保留选中的记录与快照：导入激活凭它独立核验 typed media 的依据，手动上传的视频也凭它认领。
annotations.after: Retain the selected record and snapshot for each resource: import activation independently verifies typed-media bases with them, including claims for manually uploaded videos.

annotations.before: 只保留选中记录是手动上传的资源：规划器凭这条记录与快照按上传本身判定时效。
annotations.after: Retain only resources whose selected record is a manual upload: the planner uses that record and snapshot to assess currency from the upload itself.

annotations.before: 在工作线程里收尾目录里的现有项目，``with`` 块里替换项目目录，语义同 :func:`retiring_project`。
annotations.after: Finalize an existing project in a worker thread, replacing its directory inside the ``with`` block; same semantics as :func:`retiring_project`.

annotations.before: ``render`` 车道的任务类型 → 执行器。
annotations.after: ``render`` lane task type → executor.
